evidence.snippet: FBIS DAILY REPORT MIDDLE EAST & SOUTH ASIA REVIEW 20 SEPTEMBER 1984 Lebanon U.S. Embassy Explosion — A booby-trapped vehicle exploded near the U.S. Embassy building in ‘Awkar, killing at least 40 people and wounding many others, Beirut radio announced on 20 September.
